approvals.reason: Pre-lock addition for network identity sign-in: an auth_provider.v1 capability of a network access plugin (such as Tailscale) reports sign_in_mode network. Only the web admin reads sign_in_mode, and this change teaches it the new value; silo-apple and silo-android do not read it.

Pre-lock removal for #1615: personal collection sharing is one switch (is_shared shows a collection to every profile on the login), so the per-profile allow list is no longer accepted. The web client stops sending it in the same change; silo-apple never sends it and silo-android only declares it with a null default that its JSON configuration omits (follow-ups silo-apple#534, silo-android#406).

Pre-lock removal, owner decision: the Let profiles add rule rows setting is gone and profiles may always add rule rows, so there is nothing left to read. getProfileSectionFlags keeps allow_profile_custom_sections, always true and deprecated. The web admin stops calling this operation in the same change; silo-apple and silo-android never called it. The frozen /api/v1 route keeps answering, always true.

Pre-lock removal, owner decision: the Let profiles add rule rows setting is gone and profiles may always add rule rows, so there is nothing left to change. The web admin's More menu switch, the only caller, is removed in the same change; silo-apple and silo-android never called it. The frozen /api/v1 route still accepts a write and changes nothing.
